fact: The Bank of Zambia issued fourteen designation certificates to payment service providers in 2024 (seven payment aggregators, six electronic money issuers, one money transfer operator) and revoked four.

The Bank of Zambia says it oversees the national payment systems, including the National Financial Switch, which processed K131.9 billion and 140,496,750 transactions in 2024 with 34 participants live.
The report states Zambian commercial banks process payments through the SADC Real Time Gross Settlement System (ZAR13.4 billion paid and ZAR13.9 billion received in 2024).
